key.name: language
key.description: Language code used by the application. Use "auto" to follow the system locale, or a gettext language code such as "en", "zh_CN" or "zh_HK".

key.name: use-compress-recommendation
key.description: When enabled, compression scans the selected file or folder and uses recommended 7-Zip parameters.

key.name: compress-scan-depth
key.description: Maximum number of folder levels to scan when recommending compression parameters.
